name: Effie
source: Queen Effie was one of the kindest and most gentle souls to have ever lived in the seven realms. She was a powerful magic user and only ever used this to help others in need and never for her gain. It was a shock to all when she was revealed as the bond mate of the conqueror King Lucius. They were together for several thousand years until her untimely death. Her relationship with Atlas was close, and his memories of her have an enduring impact on his actions
